newsitem.title: UK: Firstbus at record on positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Firstbus at record on positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Firstbus Plc rose to a record high on Monday after a recommendation in the Sunday Times "Insight Track" column.
The stock was up 14p at 217-1/2 by 1033 GMT, surpassing its previous intraday high of 209p set on December 11. Volume in the stock reached an active 1.5 million shares.
The column said Firstbus was the UK's largest bus operator with a bigger market share than Stagecoach Plc, whose shares have rocketed in recent months on the back of its expansion into rail services.

It noted that Firstbus had recently won the franchise to operate trains running from London's Liverpool Street station to the east and northeast of the city, and said its shares were due to catch up with those of Stagecoach.
The column said Stagecoach shares were trading on 15 times next year's expected profits compared with a multiple of 11 times for Firstbus.

The column, written by Paul Kavanagh of brokerage Killick & Co, was also positive on First Technology Plc, up 9-1/2p at 686-1/2, API Group Plc, up 4p at 725, Headlam Group Plc, up 5-1/2p at 290 and Ideal Hardware Plc, unchanged at 715p.
